content.name: CENTSCREATIVE
content.tagline: AI-powered UGC that stops the scroll and drives sales.
content.intro: UGC-style video ads and hooks made with AI. Fast tests, clean edits, no on-set filming.
content.bio: I create AI-generated UGC video ads, hooks, and scripts for short-form platforms. My background is in US healthcare customer service and chat-based sales, so I write for clear communication, persuasion, and client retention. I am building my portfolio with concept and sample work, and I am open to paid trial projects.
